title: Step 1 - Building a Reusable Framework for Nonlinear Regression Analysis in R

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So in this tutorial, we're not going to make any machine learning model, we're just going to make a template and this will be our Regression Template.
cues.zh: 這堂課不會建立機器學習模型，只會製作一個範本，也就是我們的迴歸範本。

cues.en: So it's a template that is going to be very useful for the next nonlinear regression models we're going to make.
cues.zh: 這個範本，對於接下來要建立的非線性迴歸模型非常有用。

cues.en: And also you can use this template to create a regression model for your specific problem because as you can see, you will only have a few things to change so that you will build your machine learning model
cues.zh: 你也可以使用它，為自己的特定問題建立迴歸模型，因為只需要修改少數地方，就能很有效率地

cues.en: very efficiently.
cues.zh: 建立機器學習模型。

cues.en: So let's make this template, and to make it, we're gonna go from what we did in Polynomial Regression and generalize the whole thing.
cues.zh: 來製作範本。我們會從剛才的多項式迴歸出發，把整體內容一般化。

cues.en: So I'm gonna take everything from here up to the end, copy, and I'm going to paste that in the template.
cues.zh: 我將這裡到最後的全部內容複製，貼進範本。

cues.en: And now let's make this template.
cues.zh: 現在開始整理範本。

cues.en: Okay, so first of all, let's start with the beginning.
cues.zh: 首先從開頭開始。

cues.en: So the beginning was about pre-processing the data.
cues.zh: 開頭是資料前處理。

cues.en: So actually there is nothing to change here.
cues.zh: 其實這裡沒有需要修改的地方。

cues.en: We'll keep, of course, these two lines because we will work on the Position_Salary.csv file and build our nonlinear regression models on it.
cues.zh: 當然保留這兩行，因為仍然會使用 Position_Salaries.csv 檔，在這份資料上建立非線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: And for the same reason as before, we won't need to split the dataset into a training set and a test set because this is a small dataset.
cues.zh: 和前面一樣，因為資料集很小，不將它分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And we will leave Feature Scaling as comments here since most of the libraries don't require us to apply feature scaling manually.
cues.zh: 特徵縮放也繼續保持註解，因為講者表示，大多數這裡使用的程式庫不需要我們手動縮放特徵。

cues.en: So all good for the pre-processing phase and this will be the first part of our regression template.
cues.zh: 前處理階段就完成了，這是迴歸範本的第一部分。

cues.en: Great, now let's move on to the next part.
cues.zh: 很好，進入下一部分。

cues.en: So the next part is about creating the model, creating the model, and fitting it to the dataset.
cues.zh: 下一部分是建立模型，並將模型擬合到資料集。

cues.en: So first of all, in the previous tutorial, we built two regression models, the linear regression model and the polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 先前的教學中，我們建立了兩種迴歸模型：線性迴歸與多項式迴歸。

cues.en: And that was just to compare the two results and to show you that the polynomial regression model was much more appropriate to our problem because it was a nonlinear regression model
cues.zh: 那只是為了比較兩者結果，讓你看到多項式迴歸更適合這個問題，因為它是非線性迴歸模型，

cues.en: as opposed to the linear regression model, which is a linear model.
cues.zh: 相對於線性迴歸這個線性模型而言。

cues.en: So we only did that so that you can understand very clearly the distinction between linear models and nonlinear models.
cues.zh: 我們這樣做，只是希望你能清楚理解線性模型與非線性模型的差別。

cues.en: But now that it's getting pretty clear in our mind we are gonna get rid of this section here about linear regression because now we get the idea, and we will only focus on
cues.zh: 現在概念已經很清楚，就把這裡的線性迴歸區段移除，因為已經理解了。之後只專注在

cues.en: the new nonlinear regression models themselves without comparing them to the linear regression model.
cues.zh: 新的非線性迴歸模型本身，不再和線性迴歸模型比較。

cues.en: But keep the graphic results of the linear regression model in mind.
cues.zh: 不過，請把線性迴歸模型的圖形結果記在心裡。

cues.en: Keep in mind that it was a straight line, not fitting very well the dataset, and therefore, was not much appropriate to our dataset where the data is nonlinearly distributed.
cues.zh: 記得它是一條直線，無法很好地擬合資料，因此不太適合這份呈非線性分布的資料集。

cues.en: Okay, so we're gonna get rid of this.
cues.zh: 好，刪掉這一段。

cues.en: Done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Now we only have this code section here that creates the nonlinear regression model itself.
cues.zh: 現在只留下建立非線性迴歸模型本身的程式碼區段。

cues.en: So we are gonna get rid of this because these corresponds to the polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 接著刪掉這些，因為它們專屬於多項式迴歸。

cues.en: And to generalize, we will just add a common here to specify that this is where we have to create our regressor right here.
cues.zh: 為了讓範本通用，只在這裡加上一行註解，標明這裡是建立迴歸器的位置。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And here we can also replace Polynomial Regression by the Regression Model.
cues.zh: 這裡也可以把 Polynomial Regression 改成 Regression Model。

cues.en: And we are all good with this section.
cues.zh: 這個區段就整理好了。

cues.en: Okay, now let's move on to the next one.
cues.zh: 現在進入下一段。

cues.en: The next one is about visualizing the results.
cues.zh: 下一段是結果視覺化。

cues.en: So for the same reason as what we did in this section to fit the regression model to the dataset, we will get rid of the graphic results of the linear regression model
cues.zh: 和剛才將模型擬合到資料集的區段相同，這裡也要移除線性迴歸的圖形結果，

cues.en: because we have them in mind.
cues.zh: 因為我們已經把它記在心裡。

cues.en: And we only want to focus on our future nonlinear regression models.
cues.zh: 而且只想專注於接下來的非線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: So let's get rid of this.
cues.zh: 所以刪掉這一段。

cues.en: And now we only have the graphic results of our future nonlinear regression model.
cues.zh: 現在就只剩下未來非線性迴歸模型的圖形結果。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And the great thing about the template is that in this section, we won't need to change anything, well, almost anything, because we're gonna replace Polynomial Regression by Regression Model,
cues.zh: 範本的優點是，這個區段幾乎不需要修改。只要把 Polynomial Regression 改成 Regression Model，

cues.en: and we're gonna change this poly_reg regressor here by regressor because, you know, before, we called it poly_reg, because we also had our linear regressor lin_reg.
cues.zh: 再把這裡的迴歸器 poly_reg 改成 regressor，因為先前叫 poly_reg，是因為同時還有線性迴歸器 lin_reg，

cues.en: And so we needed to make the distinction.
cues.zh: 所以需要加以區分。

cues.en: But now since we got rid of the linear regression model, we will call our future nonlinear regression model regressor here.
cues.zh: 現在既然移除了線性迴歸模型，之後的非線性迴歸模型就都命名為 regressor。

cues.en: And that's why we input regressor here in the predict function.
cues.zh: 因此 predict 函式裡輸入 regressor。

cues.en: So basically when we get to the section, when we build our future nonlinear regression model, the only thing that we'll need to change is actually the title here.
cues.zh: 基本上，之後建立新的非線性迴歸模型，進入這個區段時，唯一要修改的就是這裡的標題。

cues.en: Basically, we don't have anything to change here.
cues.zh: 其餘基本上都不需要修改。

cues.en: And that's the great thing about this template.
cues.zh: 這就是這個範本的優點。

cues.en: However, of course, if you're using this template on your dataset and your problem, well, the only thing that you will need to change are the names here of the independent variable
cues.zh: 當然，如果將範本套用到自己的資料集與問題，只需修改這裡的自變數名稱，

cues.en: and also the name of the dependent variable here.
cues.zh: 以及這裡的依變數名稱。

cues.en: That is, you'll have to replace Salary by the name of your dependent variable.
cues.zh: 也就是把 Salary 換成自己的依變數名稱。

cues.en: But that's all.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Okay, and we are finally getting to the last section of this code template, which is about predicting the final result to get our final verdict.
cues.zh: 最後來到這份程式碼範本的最後一段：預測最終結果，得出最後判定。

cues.en: Okay, so same reason as before, we're gonna get rid of the linear regression part for this.
cues.zh: 同樣基於前面的理由，這裡也要移除線性迴歸部分。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: Goodbye.
cues.zh: 再見了。

cues.en: And now we are only left with the polynomial regression prediction.
cues.zh: 現在只剩下多項式迴歸預測。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: And so now we just need to change something here.
cues.zh: 接著只需要在這裡改一點內容。

cues.en: Well, first, it's the name of the regressor because before the name of our polynomial regression, regressor was called poly_reg.
cues.zh: 首先是迴歸器的名稱，先前多項式迴歸器叫做 poly_reg。

cues.en: And now since we won't make the distinction between linear regression model and our nonlinear regression model, well, our regressor will be called regressor.
cues.zh: 現在不再區分線性迴歸與非線性迴歸模型，所以迴歸器就命名為 regressor。

cues.en: So here regressor.
cues.zh: 這裡填 regressor。

cues.en: And here, you know, for polynomial regression, we needed to input the polynomial features of our data frame that we created in our data frame.
cues.zh: 而且先前使用多項式迴歸時，必須在新建立的資料框中，輸入多項式特徵。

cues.en: Well, we won't need to do this for the next nonlinear models because this is strictly specific to the polynomial regression model where, you know, we need to add those polynomial features.
cues.zh: 接下來的非線性模型不需要這樣做，因為新增多項式特徵，是多項式迴歸模型特有的需求。

cues.en: And so we will get rid of this and we'll get something very simple.
cues.zh: 所以把這些移除，就會得到非常簡單的寫法。

cues.en: It's actually this line that will perfectly predict the salary of this 6.5 position level.
cues.zh: 只用這一行，就能預測職位等級 6.5 的薪資。
